method: Arena fetch_page was asked for public YouTube video pages. A returned 'Transcript' section is caption-like extracted text, with no assurance of original source, completeness, timestamps or accuracy. It was not independently checked against audio. It may reflect a mutable page or later state. No copyrighted full transcript is reproduced in this receipt.
